kits.name: Neon Groove
kits.desc: Bright synth-pop: punchy drums, a bouncing bass, warm chords, a hooky lead and a sparkling arpeggio.

kits.name: Rainy Lo-fi
kits.desc: Dusty lo-fi hip-hop: lazy drums, round bass, jazzy keys, a soft melody and a rain-and-vinyl texture.

kits.name: Epic Trailer
kits.desc: Cinematic and huge: taiko drums, driving strings, swelling brass and a wordless choir.

sounds.title: Neon Groove · Drums
sounds.desc: Drum stem of the Neon Groove kit: punchy kick, crisp snare and off-beat open hats at 120 BPM. Layers with the other Neon stems.

sounds.title: Neon Groove · Bass
sounds.desc: Bass stem of the Neon Groove kit: a bouncing eighth-note synth bass with octave jumps, following Am, F, C, G.

sounds.title: Neon Groove · Chords
sounds.desc: Chord stem of the Neon Groove kit: warm, pulsing synth chords (Am, F, C, G) with a gentle sidechain-style pump.

sounds.title: Neon Groove · Lead
sounds.desc: Lead stem of the Neon Groove kit: a catchy, bright synth hook with a slapback echo. Sits on top of the chords.

sounds.title: Neon Groove · Arpeggio
sounds.desc: Arpeggio stem of the Neon Groove kit: a glassy sixteenth-note arpeggio that sparkles above everything else.

sounds.title: Neon Groove · Percussion
sounds.desc: Percussion stem of the Neon Groove kit: shaker sixteenths, layered claps and a syncopated rim click.

sounds.title: Rainy Lo-fi · Drums
sounds.desc: Drum stem of the Rainy Lo-fi kit: a lazy, muffled boom-bap groove at 80 BPM.

sounds.title: Rainy Lo-fi · Bass
sounds.desc: Bass stem of the Rainy Lo-fi kit: a round, soft upright-style bass under Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7, Cmaj7.

sounds.title: Rainy Lo-fi · Keys
sounds.desc: Keys stem of the Rainy Lo-fi kit: dusty, slightly detuned jazz piano chords with a slow tape wobble.

sounds.title: Rainy Lo-fi · Melody
sounds.desc: Melody stem of the Rainy Lo-fi kit: a sparse, soft plucked melody with a warm echo.

sounds.title: Rainy Lo-fi · Rain & Vinyl
sounds.desc: Texture stem of the Rainy Lo-fi kit: soft rain on a window mixed with warm vinyl crackle and hiss.

sounds.title: Epic Trailer · Taiko Drums
sounds.desc: Drum stem of the Epic Trailer kit: thunderous taiko hits with a rolling build in the last bar.

sounds.title: Epic Trailer · Strings
sounds.desc: String stem of the Epic Trailer kit: a driving, urgent eighth-note ostinato over Dm, Bb, F, C.

sounds.title: Epic Trailer · Brass
sounds.desc: Brass stem of the Epic Trailer kit: big, swelling horn chords that rise on each chord change.

sounds.title: Epic Trailer · Choir
sounds.desc: Choir stem of the Epic Trailer kit: a wordless "ah" choir, slow and huge, holding each chord.

sounds.title: Neon Success Sting
sounds.desc: A quick, bright synth flourish resolving upward. Matches the Neon Groove kit (A minor, 120 BPM) for wins and reveals.

sounds.title: Neon Fail Sting
sounds.desc: A short synth phrase that droops downward and fizzles. Matches the Neon Groove kit for losses and mistakes.

sounds.title: Epic Impact Sting
sounds.desc: One massive orchestral hit in D minor: taiko, low brass and choir together, with a long tail. Matches the Epic Trailer kit.

sounds.title: Light Rain Layer
sounds.desc: A gentle, even drizzle with soft scattered drops. Built to sit under other layers without masking them.

sounds.title: Distant City Traffic
sounds.desc: The low wash of a city a few blocks away: cars passing, a far-off horn and a constant urban rumble.

sounds.title: Cafe Murmur
sounds.desc: A busy coffee shop: indistinct conversations all around, with the clink of cups and spoons now and then.

sounds.title: Wind in the Trees
sounds.desc: A steady breeze moving through leafy trees, swelling and easing with soft leaf rustles.

sounds.title: Room Tone with Air Conditioner
sounds.desc: The quiet sound of an indoor room: a soft air-conditioner hiss and a faint electrical hum. Great for filling silence in edits.

sounds.title: Underwater
sounds.desc: Submerged and muffled: a deep, pressing rumble with slow currents and drifting bubbles.

sounds.title: Spaceship Interior
sounds.desc: Inside a starship: a deep engine hum, circulating air and the odd soft computer chirp from the bridge.

sounds.title: Clock Shop
sounds.desc: A room full of antique clocks, each ticking at its own pace, overlapping into a gentle mechanical rhythm.

sounds.title: Magic Spell Cast
sounds.desc: A wizard casting a spell: a rising, glittering charge that bursts into a shower of sparkles.

sounds.title: Portal Opening
sounds.desc: A swirling portal tearing open: a deep drone swells while a whirling, resonant vortex spins faster and faster.

sounds.title: Bubbling Potion
sounds.desc: A thick potion bubbling in a cauldron: wet, gloopy pops over a low simmer. Loops seamlessly.

sounds.title: Crystal Sparkle
sounds.desc: A cascade of tiny crystal chimes tumbling down in pitch, glittering and delicate, like a fairy appearing.

sounds.title: Heartbeat Speeding Up
sounds.desc: A heartbeat that starts slow and calm, then races faster and louder as panic builds.

sounds.title: Glitch Error
sounds.desc: A digital error that stutters and corrupts: chopped, bit-crushed bleeps that cut out abruptly.

sounds.title: HUD Scanner
sounds.desc: A sci-fi heads-up display scanning a target: a sweeping tone with ticking data clicks, ending in a confirm beep.

sounds.title: Mechanical Keyboard Typing
sounds.desc: Fast typing on a clicky mechanical keyboard, with a satisfying space bar thock every few words.

sounds.title: Coin Shower
sounds.desc: A jackpot of coins pouring out and bouncing: dozens of bright metallic pings tumbling over each other.

sounds.title: VHS Rewind
sounds.desc: An old VHS tape rewinding: a fast, warbling, high-pitched chatter over mechanical whir, ending with a clunk.

sounds.title: Record Scratch
sounds.desc: A DJ scratching a vinyl record back and forth, the classic sound for a sudden stop or freeze-frame.

sounds.title: Phone Vibrating on a Table
sounds.desc: A phone on silent buzzing against a wooden table: two rattling bursts of vibration.

sounds.title: Elevator Ding
sounds.desc: An elevator arriving at a floor: one clear, soft bell ding that rings out.

sounds.title: Paper Crumple
sounds.desc: A sheet of paper being crushed into a ball: a burst of crisp crackles and crinkles.

sounds.title: Balloon Pop
sounds.desc: A party balloon bursting: one sharp, snappy bang with a quick rubbery flap.

sounds.title: Drop Into Water
sounds.desc: Something dropping into a pool: a deep "bloop" followed by a splash and settling ripples.

sounds.title: Dial-Up Modem
sounds.desc: A 90s modem connecting to the internet: dial tones, then a chaotic screech of handshake noise and static.

sounds.title: Countdown 3-2-1 Go
sounds.desc: A race-start countdown: three identical beeps one second apart, then a higher, longer "go" tone.

sounds.title: Ticking Tension Clock
sounds.desc: A loud, tight tick-tock at 120 BPM with a low pulse underneath, for countdowns and suspense. Locks to the Neon Groove tempo.

sounds.title: Referee Whistle
sounds.desc: A sharp, trilling pea whistle: two short blasts and one long one, like a referee stopping play.

sounds.title: Stadium Crowd Cheer
sounds.desc: A big stadium crowd erupting into a roar of cheers that swells, holds, and slowly settles. Celebratory.

sounds.title: Stadium Crowd Ambience
sounds.desc: The steady murmur of a packed stadium between plays, with scattered claps and distant shouts. Loops.

sounds.title: Stadium Air Horn
sounds.desc: Three loud, brassy air-horn blasts, the last one held. Hype and celebration.

sounds.title: Game Clock Buzzer
sounds.desc: A long, harsh, flat scoreboard buzzer that marks the end of a period. Loud and unmistakable.

sounds.title: Football Kick
sounds.desc: A solid leather thump of a foot striking a football, with a short airy follow-through.

sounds.title: Basketball Dribble
sounds.desc: A basketball bouncing on a hardwood gym floor: a steady dribble, then a few quick settling bounces.

sounds.title: Marching Snare Cadence
sounds.desc: A tight drumline cadence: crisp snare rolls and accents over a booming bass drum. Game-day energy.

sounds.title: Victory Fanfare
sounds.desc: A bold brass fanfare that climbs to a big, held major chord with a timpani roll. Winning-moment triumph.

sounds.title: Thunder Rumble
sounds.desc: A sharp crack of nearby lightning followed by a long, rolling rumble of thunder fading into the distance.

sounds.title: Forest Birdsong
sounds.desc: A bright spring morning in the woods: several small birds chirping and trilling over a soft breeze.

sounds.title: Night Crickets
sounds.desc: A warm summer night: a field of crickets chirping in steady pulses over a quiet, still background.

sounds.title: Babbling Brook
sounds.desc: A shallow stream trickling over stones, with gentle gurgles and bubbles. Calm and continuous.

sounds.title: Heavy Rainstorm
sounds.desc: A loud, dense downpour hammering the ground, with distant thunder rolling in the background.

sounds.title: Owl Hoot
sounds.desc: A soft, breathy owl calling twice in the night forest: a short hoot then a longer, wavering one.

sounds.title: Footsteps on Wood
sounds.desc: Someone walking at a relaxed pace across a hollow wooden floor, eight steps.

sounds.title: Footsteps on Gravel
sounds.desc: Crunchy footsteps walking along a gravel path outdoors, each step a gritty crunch.

sounds.title: Running Footsteps
sounds.desc: Fast, urgent running footsteps on a hard floor, like someone sprinting down a hallway.

sounds.title: Creaky Door
sounds.desc: An old wooden door slowly swinging open on rusty hinges, with a long, wavering creak.

sounds.title: Glass Shatter
sounds.desc: A pane of glass smashing: a bright crash followed by tinkling shards scattering on the floor.

sounds.title: Doorbell Ding-Dong
sounds.desc: A classic two-tone doorbell: a bright high "ding" followed by a lower, ringing "dong".

sounds.title: Kettle Whistle
sounds.desc: A stovetop kettle coming to the boil: a breathy hiss that rises into a shrill, steady whistle.

sounds.title: Microwave Beeps
sounds.desc: Three flat electronic beeps from a microwave oven telling you your food is ready.

sounds.title: Camera Shutter
sounds.desc: The quick mechanical double-click of a camera shutter taking a photo.

sounds.title: Zipper
sounds.desc: A jacket zipper being pulled up in one quick, ratcheting zip.

sounds.title: Page Turn
sounds.desc: A single page of a paperback book being turned, a soft papery swish with a light flap at the end.

sounds.title: Cash Register
sounds.desc: An old cash register: a mechanical clunk of the drawer opening and a bright bell "ching".

sounds.title: Car Horn
sounds.desc: A car horn honking twice, short then long. Impatient city traffic.

sounds.title: Car Engine Start
sounds.desc: A car starter cranking, the engine catching, revving once, and settling into a low idle.

sounds.title: Railroad Crossing Bell
sounds.desc: A railroad crossing signal: a steady, fast ding-ding-ding of a warning bell.

sounds.title: Cartoon Boing
sounds.desc: A springy, wobbling "boing" like a cartoon character bouncing off something. Silly and playful.

sounds.title: Slide Whistle Up
sounds.desc: A slide whistle gliding smoothly upward in pitch with a little wobble. Comic and goofy.

sounds.title: Slide Whistle Down
sounds.desc: A slide whistle sliding down in pitch, the classic sound of something falling or failing.

sounds.title: Bubble Pop
sounds.desc: A short, round, wet "bloop" pop, like a bubble bursting. Cute and light.

sounds.title: Cartoon Zip Away
sounds.desc: A quick rising flurry of plinky notes ending in a whoosh, like a cartoon character dashing off-screen.

sounds.title: Sad Trombone
sounds.desc: Four descending, droopy brass notes, the last one wobbling. The classic comic "you failed" sound.

sounds.title: Teleport Shimmer
sounds.desc: A sparkling, rising shimmer of glittering tones that swells and dissolves, like someone beaming away.

sounds.title: Energy Shield Up
sounds.desc: A humming energy shield powering on: a resonant sweep upward that settles into a buzzing hum.

sounds.title: Robot Chatter
sounds.desc: A small, friendly robot "talking" in a quick string of bleeps, bloops, and chirps.

sounds.title: Warp Drive Jump
sounds.desc: A spaceship charging up with a rising whine, then blasting off with a deep boom and roar.

sounds.title: Spaceship Door
sounds.desc: A sliding spaceship door: a pneumatic hiss, a smooth motorized slide, and a solid clunk.

sounds.title: Alien Planet Ambience
sounds.desc: The air of a strange alien world: low wind, a pulsing hum, and odd distant chirps. Eerie and vast.

sounds.title: Retro Gem Pickup
sounds.desc: A quick sparkly three-note arpeggio, rising. The sound of grabbing a gem in a retro game.

sounds.title: Retro Laser Shot
sounds.desc: A short, falling "pew" from an arcade spaceship blaster.

sounds.title: Retro 8-Bit Explosion
sounds.desc: A crunchy, low-fi arcade explosion: a burst of gritty noise that crumbles away.

sounds.title: Menu Select Blip
sounds.desc: A tiny, clean blip for moving a cursor between menu options.

sounds.title: Extra Life
sounds.desc: A cheerful six-note rising chiptune jingle for earning a bonus life.

sounds.title: Pause Sound
sounds.desc: Two quick, bright chiptune notes, down then up. Signals that the game is paused.

sounds.title: Sword Clash
sounds.desc: Two steel blades striking: a bright metallic clang with a long, shimmering ring.

sounds.title: Metal Clang
sounds.desc: A heavy metal pipe being struck, a hard clang that rings out with a hollow, inharmonic tone.

sounds.title: Wooden Thud
sounds.desc: A dull, solid thud of something hitting a wooden crate.

sounds.title: Body Fall
sounds.desc: A heavy, muffled thump of a body falling to the floor, with a short rustle of clothes.

sounds.title: Cinematic Boom
sounds.desc: A huge trailer-style impact: a deep sub-bass drop with a crashing hit and a long, dark tail.

sounds.title: Reverse Cymbal Swell
sounds.desc: A crash cymbal played backwards: a hissing shimmer that swells up and cuts off sharply.

sounds.title: Tape Stop
sounds.desc: Music grinding to a halt like a tape machine losing power, pitch sliding down to nothing.

sounds.title: Deep Swoosh
sounds.desc: A deep, heavy whoosh of something big swinging past quickly.

sounds.title: Ghostly Whispers
sounds.desc: Breathy, unintelligible whispering voices drifting in and out in a dark, empty space. Unnerving.

sounds.title: Horror Tension Stinger
sounds.desc: A cluster of screeching, dissonant strings that crescendos fast and stabs, for a jump scare.

sounds.title: Haunted Music Box
sounds.desc: A slow, slightly out-of-tune music box playing a sad waltz that winds down. Creepy and childlike.

sounds.title: Smoke Alarm
sounds.desc: A piercing smoke detector: three loud, high beeps, a pause, then three more.

sounds.title: School Bell
sounds.desc: A loud electric school bell ringing continuously, a rapid metallic rattle, then stopping.

sounds.title: Digital Watch Alarm
sounds.desc: A tiny digital wristwatch alarm: quick pairs of thin, high beeps repeating.

sounds.title: Game Show Correct
sounds.desc: A bright, happy double bell "ding-ding" for a correct answer on a quiz show.

sounds.title: Game Show Wrong Buzzer
sounds.desc: A loud, low, raspy buzzer for a wrong answer on a quiz show.

sounds.title: Trap Beat
sounds.desc: A modern trap beat: booming 808 bass, sharp claps, and rattling hi-hat rolls over a dark bell melody.

sounds.title: Drum and Bass Break
sounds.desc: A fast, rolling drum-and-bass breakbeat with a deep, growling sub bass. Urgent and high-energy.

sounds.title: Sad Piano
sounds.desc: A slow, gentle solo piano in a minor key, with soft broken chords and a simple, aching melody.

sounds.title: Jazz Brush Groove
sounds.desc: A laid-back swing: brushed snare and ride cymbal with a warm walking upright bass. Cafe and lounge vibes.

sounds.title: Uplifting Corporate
sounds.desc: A bright, optimistic background track: plucky guitar-like patterns, warm pads, and a steady light beat.

sounds.title: Cyberpunk Pulse
sounds.desc: A gritty, pulsing dark-synth groove: a driving sixteenth-note bass, heavy drums, and cold stabs.

sounds.title: Chiptune Boss Battle
sounds.desc: A fast, urgent 8-bit battle theme in a minor key with a racing bass line. Final-boss tension.

sounds.title: Tension Underscore
sounds.desc: A suspenseful underscore: low, pulsing string ostinato with a ticking pulse and a slow, rising drone.

sounds.title: Bossa Nova Evening
sounds.desc: A gentle bossa nova: syncopated nylon-guitar-style chords, a soft shaker, and a light bass. Breezy and warm.

sounds.title: Lo-fi Rainy Day
sounds.desc: A cozy lo-fi hip-hop loop: dusty, mellow jazz chords, a lazy beat, vinyl crackle, and soft rain.

sounds.title: Ambient Piano Space
sounds.desc: Sparse, gentle piano notes floating over a soft pad in a wide, echoing space. Peaceful and unhurried.

sounds.title: Island Reggae Groove
sounds.desc: A laid-back reggae groove: offbeat chord "skanks", a round, deep bass, and a one-drop beat.

sounds.title: Soft UI Click
sounds.desc: A very short, soft, high-pitched tick, like tapping a glass screen.

sounds.title: Confirm Chime
sounds.desc: Two bright bell tones rising in pitch, friendly and reassuring. Signals success.

sounds.title: Error Buzz
sounds.desc: A short, low, raspy double buzz that clearly says "no" or "wrong".

sounds.title: Notification Pop
sounds.desc: A quick upward "bloop", like a bubble popping. Light and playful.

sounds.title: Toggle Switch
sounds.desc: Two tiny mechanical clicks close together, like flipping a light switch.

sounds.title: Keyboard Typing
sounds.desc: Irregular rapid clicking of a mechanical keyboard, as if someone is typing a sentence.

sounds.title: Clock Ticking
sounds.desc: A steady wall-clock tick-tock, one tick per second, alternating slightly different pitches.

sounds.title: Door Knock
sounds.desc: Three firm knocks on a wooden door, evenly spaced.

sounds.title: Water Drip
sounds.desc: Single water droplets falling into a still pool with a rising "plip" and a little cave echo.

sounds.title: Phone Ringing
sounds.desc: A classic landline ring: a warbling two-tone ring for two seconds, then a pause, twice.

sounds.title: Rain on a Window
sounds.desc: Steady medium rain hissing against glass with occasional heavier droplets. Calm and continuous.

sounds.title: Ocean Waves
sounds.desc: Slow waves rolling onto a sandy beach and washing back out, about every eight seconds.

sounds.title: Howling Wind
sounds.desc: Cold wind gusting and whistling, rising and falling in pitch. Lonely and eerie.

sounds.title: Campfire Crackle
sounds.desc: A cozy fire: a low, soft roar with frequent small pops and snaps of burning wood.

sounds.title: Heartbeat
sounds.desc: A deep, muffled "lub-dub" heartbeat at a resting pace of about 67 beats per minute.

sounds.title: Creepy Stinger
sounds.desc: A sudden harsh, dissonant orchestral-like stab that swells and fades into an unsettling hum.

sounds.title: Laser Zap
sounds.desc: A fast, bright "pew" that sweeps sharply downward in pitch. Classic sci-fi blaster.

sounds.title: Sonar Ping
sounds.desc: A pure, clear ping followed by fading echoes, like a submarine sonar in deep water.

sounds.title: Power Up
sounds.desc: An electric hum that rises quickly in pitch and brightness, like a machine charging up.

sounds.title: Power Down
sounds.desc: A machine winding down: a whine that falls in pitch and fades into silence.

sounds.title: Spaceship Engine Hum
sounds.desc: A deep, steady mechanical rumble with a faint pulsing throb, like the inside of a starship.

sounds.title: Radio Static
sounds.desc: Crackly radio static that fades in and out with bursts of interference.

sounds.title: Digital Glitch
sounds.desc: Rapid stuttering digital chirps and buzzes, like corrupted data or a hacked screen.

sounds.title: Retro Coin Pickup
sounds.desc: Two quick bright square-wave notes jumping up, the classic 8-bit "collect a coin" sound.

sounds.title: Retro Jump
sounds.desc: A springy 8-bit "boing" that quickly slides upward in pitch.

sounds.title: Retro Damage Hit
sounds.desc: A crunchy 8-bit noise burst that drops in pitch, signaling the player took damage.

sounds.title: Level Up Fanfare
sounds.desc: A short, triumphant ascending run of chiptune notes ending on a held high note.

sounds.title: Game Over
sounds.desc: A slow, descending sequence of sad chiptune notes, ending low. Clearly a defeat.

sounds.title: Deep Explosion
sounds.desc: A big, deep boom with a sharp crack at the start and a long rumbling tail.

sounds.title: Punch Impact
sounds.desc: A short, heavy, meaty thump, like a fist landing a solid hit.

sounds.title: Fast Whoosh
sounds.desc: A quick rush of air sweeping past from one side to the other. Great for scene transitions.

sounds.title: Cinematic Riser
sounds.desc: A six-second build of noise and climbing tones that grows louder and higher, then cuts off.

sounds.title: Countdown Beeps
sounds.desc: Three short medium beeps one second apart, then one long higher beep: "3, 2, 1, go!"

sounds.title: Alarm Siren
sounds.desc: A loud electronic siren sweeping up and down in pitch, urgent and attention-grabbing.

sounds.title: Temple Bell
sounds.desc: One deep, rich bell strike with a shimmering overtone that rings out for several seconds.

sounds.title: Lo-fi Study Chords
sounds.desc: Warm, mellow electric-piano chords (Cmaj7, Am7, Fmaj7, G7) over a lazy drum beat. Cozy and relaxed.

sounds.title: Dark Ambient Drone
sounds.desc: A slow, deep, evolving low drone with distant dissonant overtones. Brooding and unsettling.

sounds.title: Calm Meditation Pad
sounds.desc: Soft, airy synth chords gently swelling in and out. Peaceful, spacious, and slow.

sounds.title: Driving House Beat
sounds.desc: A punchy four-on-the-floor kick with crisp off-beat hi-hats and claps. Danceable and driving.

sounds.title: Boom Bap Beat
sounds.desc: A classic head-nodding hip-hop drum groove with a heavy kick and a snappy snare on two and four.

sounds.title: Neon Synthwave Arp
sounds.desc: A pulsing 80s-style synth arpeggio over a deep bass and steady beat. Nostalgic night-drive energy.

sounds.title: Chiptune Adventure
sounds.desc: An upbeat, bouncy 8-bit melody with a pulsing square-wave bass. Cheerful video-game adventure.

sounds.title: Gentle Piano Theme
sounds.desc: A tender solo-piano progression (C, G, Am, F) with a simple melody on top. Hopeful and heartfelt.

sounds.title: Epic Trailer Drums
sounds.desc: Thunderous, booming taiko-style drums in a driving war rhythm with a big hall echo.

sounds.title: Funky Bassline
sounds.desc: A bouncy, syncopated synth-bass groove with octave jumps over a tight beat. Funky and playful.

sounds.title: Music Box Lullaby
sounds.desc: A delicate, tinkling music-box melody in a slow waltz. Sweet, innocent, a little nostalgic.

sounds.title: Podcast Intro Jingle
sounds.desc: A five-second bright, upbeat sting: plucky synth notes climb to a final chord with a cymbal swell.
